scope: Offline source/parser review after root-operated first hardware decode; no board access by this reviewer.

first_hardware_evidence.limit: First seven frame contents match the reference; this is not full 30-frame or sustained playback acceptance.

trace_observation: Root trace reports complete 38003-byte input read and parser EOF exit; decoder repeatedly obtains/releases 0x310/0x311 locks without a blocking IRQ wait. No driver timeout/poison observed.

confirmed_parser_defect.independent_validation: code_index ran original and fixed parser with ASan/UBSan against the same fixed fixture; fixed parser consumes all bytes.
confirmed_parser_defect.causal_limit: Dropping the last NAL explains a missing final frame, but does not independently explain a seven-frame stall.

unconfirmed_buffer_hypothesis: Original demo retains one display picture while missing cedarc.conf selects nDisplayHoldingFrameBufferNum=0. Diagnostic v2 returns each saved picture immediately and records all decoder result transitions and SBM/FBM counts; still needs board evidence.
corrected_review_statement: Initial suspicion of int* passed to pthread_join was incorrect: original ChannelThread nRet was already void*. v2 uses int for initDecoder status and NULL for ignored join result, removing the vendor int-to-pointer warning; no stack-overflow cause is claimed.

changes: Immediate ReturnPicture after saving, with return-code check.
Decode return transitions, periodic progress, SBM/FBM counts, EOF and saved frame diagnostics.
Separate integer initialization status from unused pthread_join return values; remove vendor int-to-pointer warning.
limits: Parser validated offline only; hardware completion remains pending.
No modification to original WC bundle or Tina source.
Run through the private WC wrapper; this executable is a separate private artifact.

deployment: Use the existing cedar-env wrapper with the separate vdecoderdemo-diagnostic-v2 executable. Do not overwrite the WC bundle or use the frozen original-demo comparator without explicitly changing/pinning the selected executable.
